quotes.text: A frost spirit urged her to keep it all, promising that no one could see through the river's mist.
A frost spirit urged her to keep it all, promising that no one could see through the river's mist.
Beyond the Tide Mother's sea stood eight towers
Neri waited for sunrise instead of judging a heart by one blurred crossing.
A jealous frost spirit asked why neither hoarded their light.

note: Tide Mother's towers; frost spirit, sea witch and Fog King tempt hoarding or accusation, all rejected; equalizing returns.

quotes.text: Keep them all; no one can see your basket.
Keep them all; no one can see your basket.
On Echo Mountain, eight lantern keepers guarded a bridge spun from moonbeams.
Mist changes what eyes report, not what hearts have done.

note: Owl's two wings (gratitude, sustenance); fox, frost spirit, shadow and Fog King tempt hoarding or blame, rejected each time.

quotes.text: In the valley of Eight Lanterns, a bridge carried fireseeds across a winter gorge.
he did not mistake an uncertain count for a stingy heart.

note: Nera and Oren in the valley of Eight Lanterns; return half each time; keepers nearly withhold over a missing coal but don't.

quotes.text: Keep everything. The moon cannot see.
Keep everything. The moon cannot see.
In the valley of Eight Lanterns, the moon gave five seeds to a traveler.
An uncertain crossing is not proof of an ungenerous heart.
yesterday’s dim return does not name tomorrow’s keeper.
What if the returning flames seem fewer tomorrow?
What if the returning flames seem fewer tomorrow?

note: Eight Lanterns well and moon; frost and fox tempt hoarding or blame; a shortchanged giver still sends all to a new keeper.

quotes.text: The river murmured that she could keep them all.
In the valley of Eight Lanterns, the moon planted a firetree beside a river.
Fog changes what eyes report, not what faithful hands have done.

note: Lantern Road mill and firetree; Sen, Luma, Liora; mist spirit and Fog King push suspicion; return half throughout.

quotes.text: “Keep them all,” whispered the frost to the traveler who received them. “Send none,” it whispered to the one who held the seeds.
Long ago, eight villages gathered beneath the Mountain of Echoes.
Judge a traveler by repeated kindness, not by a single uncertain glimmer.

note: Mountain of Echoes forge and lantern bridge; Sela and Orin; frost and shadow urge hoarding, rejected; seven of fifteen returned.

quotes.text: “Call it theft,” he whispered, “and keep everything next time.”
Each dawn, the Tide Mother placed five fireseeds in one traveler's hand.
Mist alters appearances, not intentions.

note: Bridge of Embers, Tide Mother, lantern tree; Fog King and sea witch urge accusation and keeping everything, rejected.

quotes.text: The Frost Fox whispered that he should keep them all: nobody on the far bank could see his hands.
Keep them. The giver cannot see your basket.
In the valley below Echo Mountain, eight households tended an orchard of lantern trees.
Mist sometimes hid an apple, making a generous hand seem stingy.
A frost spirit asked why anyone would give fruit back when the orchard demanded nothing.
remembering that the planter had risked more than the empty earth showed.

note: Threefold Orchard then Echo Mountain lantern orchard; tempters say no one can see; keepers return half or seven of fifteen.

phrase: Mist/fog changes what eyes report, not what hands have done
note: Shared settings too: valley of Eight Lanterns, Tide Mother, Echo Mountain, Fog King across most agents.
